name: Brutalist
means: Raw concrete as aesthetic: massive unadorned forms, board-marked surfaces, grey monochrome, hard overhead light, oppressive scale.
tags: brutalist architecture, raw concrete, massive forms, monochrome grey, harsh light
prose: a brutalist treatment - raw board-marked concrete in massive unadorned forms, grey monochrome, hard overhead light
works_for: video - the architecture claim is CONFIRMED and the shot-level claim is not. Over 8.04s large static forms (concrete, brick) hold rock-steady in position and texture with no morphing. But this rendered photographically, and it took the same failure as photorealistic: the subject walked past camera and by 8s the frame is out-of-focus motion (detail 0.442, the largest fall measured; octiles ramp down from the 4s mark). At 4s the clip is clean (detail 0.934). Stable for architecture; keep the shot to ~4s if a person is in it.

video_verdict.failure: architecture holds rock-steady; the subject walks past camera and the shot dies
video_verdict.saw: Two results in one clip. The card's actual claim - large static forms are the most stable case there is - is confirmed without reservation: the concrete slab and brick wall hold rock-steady in position and texture through frame 165, with no morphing or creep. But the same failure as photorealistic then destroys the shot: the subject walks toward and past camera, and by frame 192 the frame is out-of-focus motion. The octiles ramp down from the fourth eighth (1.00 1.00 1.00 0.95 0.89 0.80 0.66 0.45) to detail 0.442, the largest fall in the sweep, while detail at 4s is a healthy 0.934.
video_verdict.measured_on: One 193-frame (8.04s) LTX-2.3 image-to-video clip, workflow 12_ltx23_i2v_audio.json at its shipping settings, from a keyframe rendered on this style's own engine at 1280x704. Held constant across every style in the sweep: subject, keyframe seed 7204, video seed 8801, motion prompt, clip length. MEASURED BY RENDERING AND LOOKING, NOT PREDICTED.
video_verdict.caveats: boil is NOT a style-stability number in this sweep - it tracks how much the clip moved, and the identical motion prompt produced motion from 0.345 to 2.772 across styles. detail is the load-bearing number, and it too drops when the COMPOSITION changes rather than the texture. Read both against the strips. n=1 clip, one subject, one seed.
